title: Asset Receipt
description: Receipt: which team assets a run used and in what state. Shows only what the evidence chain can prove, never one level more. Wording rule: render 'related test X passed', never 'verified: test passed' — the latter reads as a causal claim the evidence does not support.

applied_count.description: How many assets were applied in this run (records at state fetched or beyond).

corrected.description: used, and the call it fed failed for a reason the content explains. Counted apart from used and validated.

soft_only_count.description: Count of soft-evidence-only records. Reported separately; never folded into used.

category.description: The topic's asset taxonomy (project convention / historical solution / failure experience / skill / code knowledge / product knowledge). Taken from what the asset itself declares (frontmatter `category`) or, for a skill record, the taxonomy entry 'skill'. Never inferred from wording: an undeclared knowledge or memory record is not_declared.

why_applicable.description: Why the asset was offered for this task, stated from the retrieval system's own record (the model's query, the asset's rank and score in the reply), never from a reason written after the fact. Null when no retrieval call in this run offered the asset.

status.description: Maps to the status marks. used_soft stands alone and must not be rendered as a plain check mark. corrected: the asset was used and the call it fed failed for a reason its content explains; rendered as a cross, never folded into used.

producer_user_id.description: The required 'source' field: who wrote the asset.

impact.description: Where it was used in this run: what it affected, in human terms.

evidence.description: References to the corresponding change or test. May be empty when status=provided.

related_tests.description: Rendered as 'related test X passed'. Must not be written as 'verified: test passed'.

risks.description: Conflict, staleness, low confidence, not admitted by the gate, or a use that could not be tied to this asset's own content (needs_review).

author_confidence.description: Null when not computable; rendered as 'no cross-person validation yet', never as 0.
